findings.subject: AtomWidget
findings.summary: At accessibility text sizes widget tiles overflow their square cells and overlap each other; the error tile's retry button is cut off.
findings.evidence: examples/ios-demo/Atom63DemoTests/__Snapshots__/iPhone-17-Pro_iOS-26.2/widgetCard.large-type.png; packages/ui-ios/Sources/Atom63UI/AtomWidget.swift:153-185 (cell size from width only), :54 (card fills, does not clip or cap).
findings.fix: Cap Dynamic Type inside AtomWidgetCard (e.g. .dynamicTypeSize(...DynamicTypeSize.xxLarge), as WidgetKit does) and/or let the grid grow a row to fit content at AX sizes; add an AX3 test that no tile exceeds its cell.

verified.reason: AtomWidgetGrid sizes cells from width only (cell(for:) in sizeThatFits/placeSubviews), and AtomWidgetCard fills its frame with no clip or type cap. The widgetCard.large-type.png snapshot shows the top-row tiles running into the Release tile, and the error tile's 'Try again' button cut off at the bottom. Text scaling is part of K5, so this blocks ready.

findings.subject: AtomSyncStatusView
findings.summary: Every sync label is hard-coded English rendered verbatim, with no override, so the component cannot ship in a non-English product.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-ios/Sources/Atom63UI/AtomSyncStatusView.swift:25,42-57 (Text(title) with String, never localized); docs/coverage.md 'Remaining production work: localization resources instead of demo strings'.
findings.fix: Accept caller labels (a label closure or LocalizedStringResource per intent, as AtomPageDots does with pageLabel) or ship a String Catalog in the package with Bundle.module lookups.

verified.reason: AtomSyncStatusView.swift has title as a computed String with six hard-coded English literals, passed to Text(String), so no localization lookup happens. The init takes only intent, so a caller cannot override the label. coverage.md lists localization as 'Remaining production work', which admits the gap rather than closing it. Unlike other components, a caller cannot supply translated text.

findings.subject: AtomContentStateView
findings.summary: The error state's retry action is drawn as a destructive (red) button, signalling data loss for a harmless retry and diverging from web Empty, which uses an outline Retry.
findings.fix: Use a neutral/outline AtomButton for the error recovery action (match web), keep .destructive only for actions that destroy data.

verified.reason: It is real: line 43 maps tone .error to AtomButton tone .destructive, the dark snapshot shows a red 'Try again', and web Empty uses variant="outline" for Retry. But nothing is missing, broken or inaccessible. White on #BB1D22 passes contrast. The error state is designed and captured, so K4's state coverage is met. This is a design-semantics mismatch across platforms, not a blocker.

findings.evidence: packages/ui-ios/Sources/Atom63UI/AtomContentStateView.swift:37-38,54-55; actionDanger #BB1D22 in both modes (Generated/Atom63Tokens.generated.swift:73) vs surfacePage dark #111; examples/ios-demo/Atom63DemoTests/__Snapshots__/iPhone-17-Pro_iOS-26.2/contentState.light.png shows the red title.
findings.fix: Tint only the icon (Label { Text(title) } icon: { Image(...).foregroundStyle(iconColor) }) and keep the title textPrimary; use a text-danger role color for any red text.

verified.reason: .foregroundStyle(iconColor) is on the whole Label, and the dark snapshot shows the title 'Couldn't load projects' in red. I measured #BB1D22 on #111111 at 2.98:1. But ContentUnavailableView's title is large bold text (title2 bold, about 22pt), so the WCAG threshold is 3:1, not 4.5:1. It misses by 0.02, and the message and button stay readable. It is a real but marginal failure, fixed by tinting only the icon, so P2 rather than a ready-blocker.

findings.subject: AtomNotice
findings.summary: The error notice's action label is actionDanger text on surfaceMuted, 2.48:1 in dark mode, failing 4.5:1.
findings.fix: Give iOS a mode-aware danger text color (Swift counterpart of --a63-text-danger, danger-400 in dark) and use it for error text and the action label; keep actionDanger for fills.

verified.reason: AtomNotice puts .foregroundStyle(tint) on the action Button, and for .error the tint is actionDanger (AtomSemanticTone.swift:23). actionDanger is #BB1D22 in both modes, and dark surfaceMuted is #222222. I measured 2.51:1 at subheadline semibold (about 15pt, normal-size text, so 4.5:1 applies). AtomTheme passes the token straight through, so no wrapper or theme override fixes it. It is a clear contrast failure on an interactive label.

findings.subject: Batch 10 (all 14)
findings.summary: iOS visual baselines capture only the standard (modern) theme, so aqua, retro and terminal and their archetypes are never seen for any iOS component.
findings.fix: Add per-skin variants (AtomTheme(skin:) for aqua, retro, terminal) to the catalog snapshot matrix, at least for light/dark, so YZ's contact sheet has 4 themes x 2 modes.

findings.subject: Batch 10 (all 14)
findings.summary: iOS components use action fill tokens (actionPrimary, actionDanger) as text and icon colors; the new token-role rule does not scan Swift, and iOS has no text-danger/text-accent role on AtomThemeColors. In dark mode these measure 2.5-2.9:1.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-ios/Sources/Atom63UI/AtomListRow.swift:35, AtomValueRow.swift:68, AtomSelectionRow.swift:43, AtomSyncStatusView.swift:81,87, AtomSemanticTone.swift:23, AtomContentStateView.swift:55, AtomWidgetState.swift:89; craft-baseline.json token-role entries are web-only (no .swift path); AtomTheme.swift:3-43 has no textDanger/textAccent.
findings.fix: Add textAccent/textDanger (theme-aware) to AtomThemeColors from the token graph, switch foreground uses to them, and extend the token-role check to Swift sources.

findings.subject: Batch 10 (all 14)
findings.summary: Compact density reaches only 4 of the 14 (AppBar, ListRow, ValueRow, SectionHeader); ActionBar, ListSection, SelectionRow, Chip, Notice, SyncStatus, TabRow and the widget ignore atomDensity, so a compact screen mixes two densities.
findings.evidence: README.md:83-87 (density-aware list); e.g. AtomSelectionRow.swift:27, AtomChip.swift:35-36, AtomNotice.swift:36,67, AtomActionBar.swift:45, AtomListSection.swift:68,79.
findings.fix: Read @Environment(\.atomDensity) and use density.space/textStyle in each, keeping 44pt targets; extend AtomDensityTests to the list.

findings.subject: Batch 10 (all 14)
findings.summary: Nine of the 14 have no behaviour test at all (ActionBar, ListRow, SectionHeader, SelectionRow, ValueRow, Chip, Notice action, SyncStatus, ContentState); only snapshots guard them.
findings.evidence: grep of packages/ui-ios/Tests/Atom63UITests for each type name finds only AtomAppBar, AtomTabRow, AtomPageDots, AtomListSection, AtomWidget* and AtomNotice enum use.
findings.fix: Add Swift Testing cases for paired-optional actions, selection traits, loading/disabled, AX restacking and sync intent labels.

findings.subject: AtomActionBar
findings.summary: The action bar's panel fill stops at the bottom safe area, so the home-indicator strip shows the page color under it when placed as documented.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-ios/Sources/Atom63UI/AtomActionBar.swift:46 (no ignoresSafeArea) vs AtomAppBar.swift:62-63; docs/building-blocks.md:119-121 places it in safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom).
findings.fix: Extend the background with .background { color.ignoresSafeArea(edges: .bottom) }.

findings.subject: AtomActionBar
findings.summary: The primary button is configured through the legacy AtomButtonVariant instead of tone and emphasis, and the secondary action is two optionals that silently drop if one is missing.
findings.fix: Take primaryTone/primaryEmphasis (or an AtomButton configuration) and a single optional secondary (title, action) pair.

findings.subject: AtomActionBar
findings.summary: No disabled state for the primary action, so a form screen cannot show Save as unavailable.
findings.fix: Add isPrimaryDisabled (or honor .disabled from the environment) and capture it in the catalog.

findings.subject: AtomListRow
findings.summary: The icon tile is a fixed 32/28pt square while the glyph and text scale, so the tile is undersized and the glyph crowds it at accessibility sizes.
findings.fix: Make the tile size @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) (capped) so it tracks Dynamic Type.

findings.subject: AtomListRow
findings.summary: No contract or CLI entry maps AtomListRow, so `atom63 component` and search cannot lead a builder to it.
findings.evidence: grep of packages/ui-foundation/contracts/components finds no AtomListRow; README.md and docs/building-blocks.md only.
findings.fix: Map it in the item contract's swiftUIRenderer notes (like AtomValueRow) and regenerate the index.

findings.subject: AtomListRow
findings.summary: As a NavigationLink/Button label the row has no designed pressed highlight or disabled look; only the rest state is captured.
findings.fix: Provide an Atom row button style (pressed = surfaceMuted fill) used by ListRow/ValueRow, and capture pressed and disabled.

findings.subject: AtomListSection
findings.summary: The iOS 17 path walks children with the private underscored _VariadicView API.
findings.fix: Raise the floor to iOS 18 for this view, or take rows as an explicit collection on iOS 17; do not depend on _VariadicView.

findings.subject: AtomListSection
findings.summary: Row height 52 and corner radius 18 are literals with no Swift token (web --radius-2xl / --a63-inset-*), and header/footer ignore density.
findings.fix: Generate the inset-group tokens into AtomTokens and read them here; apply density to header/footer.

findings.subject: AtomSectionHeader
findings.summary: The header action draws in the system accent color, not the theme's, so it is off-brand next to Atom63 controls (provisional, YZ confirms).
findings.evidence: packages/ui-ios/Sources/Atom63UI/AtomSectionHeader.swift:42-43; examples/ios-demo/Atom63DemoTests/__Snapshots__/iPhone-17-Pro_iOS-26.2/sectionHeader.light.png ('Manage' in system blue vs the theme blue of actionBar.light.png).
findings.fix: Tint the button from theme (textAccent once it exists, else actionPrimary) or make it an AtomButton ghost/link.

findings.subject: AtomSectionHeader
findings.summary: The header action is a text-only button with no minimum height, so its hit area is about 20pt.
findings.fix: Give it .frame(minHeight: AtomTokens.Control.minTouchTarget) with contentShape, as AtomNotice does at :64.

findings.subject: AtomSectionHeader
findings.summary: actionTitle and action (also on AtomNotice and AtomContentStateView) are separate optionals; passing one without the other silently renders nothing.
findings.fix: Replace each pair with one optional action value (title + closure) or overloads that require both.

findings.subject: AtomSectionHeader
findings.summary: No contract or CLI entry names AtomSectionHeader.
findings.evidence: grep of contracts and packages/cli finds none.
findings.fix: Map it (e.g. in the item or card contract) and regenerate the agent index.

findings.subject: AtomSelectionRow
findings.summary: The selected checkmark uses actionPrimary, 2.93:1 on the panel in dark mode, and the rows expose no group semantics for a single-choice set.
findings.fix: Use a theme-aware accent text/icon color with >=3:1, and document or provide a container (AtomSelectionGroup) that labels the set.

findings.subject: AtomSelectionRow
findings.summary: Ignores density, uses a literal 44 and sets no title font, unlike its sibling rows.
findings.fix: Read atomDensity, use density.textStyle(.body) and AtomTokens.Control.minTouchTarget.

findings.subject: AtomSelectionRow
findings.summary: No disabled state is designed or captured.
findings.fix: Style the environment's isEnabled with actionDisabledForeground and capture it.

findings.subject: AtomPageDots
findings.summary: Resting dots measure 1.64:1 (light) and 2.13:1 (dark) against the page, below 3:1 for a page indicator.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-ios/Sources/Atom63UI/AtomPageDots.swift:144-148; computed from textSecondary and surfacePage in Generated/Atom63Tokens.generated.swift:41,53.
findings.fix: Raise the rest opacity (or use borderInput, which is specified at 3:1) so rest dots clear 3:1.

findings.subject: AtomPageDots
findings.summary: Round dots are 16pt-wide tap targets, below the 44pt bar (documented trade-off).
findings.fix: Keep 16pt visual pitch but extend each dot's contentShape to share the row so the row is tappable at 44pt, or accept as a documented exception (YZ).

findings.subject: AtomChip
findings.summary: The selected chip is always accent-filled with no tone or size axis, while the toggle contract it renders defaults to tone neutral and AGENTS rule 5 makes selection neutral by default.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-ios/Sources/Atom63UI/AtomChip.swift:55-65; `atom63 component toggle` axes sizes sm|md|lg, tones neutral|accent|subtle default neutral.
findings.fix: Add tone (.neutral default, .accent) and map sizes, per the contract.

findings.subject: AtomChip
findings.summary: The contract's required 'disabled' state has no design on iOS; the chip relies on .plain dimming and has no pressed style.
findings.fix: Draw disabled from actionDisabled* tokens and a pressed fill; capture both.

findings.subject: AtomChip
findings.summary: `atom63 search AtomChip` returns no results.
findings.evidence: pnpm -s atom63 search AtomChip -> 'No results for "AtomChip"'.
findings.fix: Index iOS renderer names as search synonyms (packages/cli/src/synonyms.mjs already does this for AtomTabRow/AtomPageDots).

findings.subject: AtomNotice
findings.summary: AtomNotice lacks the alert contract's default (neutral) variant.
findings.fix: Add .neutral (AtomSemanticTone.neutral already exists) and make it the default to match the contract.

findings.subject: AtomNotice
findings.summary: The VoiceOver tone prefix ('Information', 'Error') is hard-coded English with no override.
findings.fix: Localize via a package String Catalog (Bundle.module) or accept a toneLabel parameter.

findings.subject: AtomSyncStatusView
findings.summary: The failed and offline states offer no recovery action.
findings.fix: Accept an optional retry action shown for .failed (and .offline), styled neutral.

findings.subject: AtomSyncStatusView
findings.summary: No contract maps AtomSyncStatusView and the CLI cannot find it.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 search sync status` returns badge/chat-steps/message; grep of contracts finds none.
findings.fix: Map it to a web counterpart contract (feedback-state or a sync pattern) and index it.

findings.subject: AtomWidget
findings.summary: Widget headers truncate to two letters at AX3, and the retry label is a literal looked up only in the app bundle.
findings.fix: Allow two lines (or minimumScaleFactor) in the header and cap type in tiles; localize via Bundle.module or a parameter.

findings.subject: AtomPageDots
findings.summary: The pill shape spreads the dots on a 44pt pitch, visibly looser than the round row and than CarouselDots pill.
findings.fix: YZ to decide the pill pitch; keep the hit area via contentShape rather than spacing.

findings.subject: AtomListSection
findings.summary: Section headers are headline semibold; iOS Settings uses a small secondary label, so the inset list reads heavier than native.
findings.fix: YZ to choose between the current heading and a footnote secondary header style.

findings.subject: AtomListRow
findings.summary: Inside a section the row gets x1 vertical padding plus the section's x2 insets, so it is taller than AtomSelectionRow in the same section.
findings.fix: Apply the x1 padding only outside a section (as AtomSelectionRow does with listRowInsets == nil).

findings.subject: Batch 10 (all 14)
findings.summary: docs/coverage.md is stale: it counts 42 catalog entries and 29 contracts and omits the widget components.
findings.fix: Regenerate or update the counts and add AtomWidget* to the ownership table.

findings.subject: AtomTabRow
findings.summary: Tab labels use fixed text styles and a literal 44, so compact density does not reach them.
findings.fix: Use density.textStyle and AtomTokens.Control.minTouchTarget.
